purpose: Phase 17 Task 13 high-capability Android TV reference-device validation without claiming unobserved SHIELD behavior.

preflight.firmware_rule: Install the current NVIDIA SHIELD Experience system update and record the observed system version before each run.
preflight.display_chain_rule: Record the exact TV or AVR, HDMI topology, HDMI/HDCP capability, HDR mode, and audio route. Do not infer an output format from SHIELD or Android codec APIs alone.
preflight.network_rule: Run the same legal test profile once on Ethernet and once on Wi-Fi. NVIDIA recommends Ethernet for maximum performance; record only the transport class, never SSID, IP address, MAC address, or credential.
preflight.test_media_rule: Use legal, non-private test media representing the declared stream decisions and tracks. Do not commit media, account details, signed URLs, support bundles, or screenshots containing private catalog data.

checks: ADB target is a physical NVIDIA SHIELD with Leanback support
Duskcue package is installed or the supplied APK installs
Leanback launcher and valid-shape Duskcue deep-link handoff succeed
Reported Android release/API, display size, advertised HDR tokens, app version, and chosen network transport are emitted as a privacy-safe preflight record
machine_preflight.scope_limit: The command does not prove authentication, media decode, HDR output, AVR passthrough, AI upscaling, Watch Next visibility, or standby/resume. Those remain manual observations.

test_cases.observation: On the intended Play Android TV track, confirm listing/install visibility and capture the result without account data.
test_cases.evidence: Play track, app version, SHIELD model/firmware, observed install outcome

test_cases.observation: Run browse, device link, direct play, direct stream, HLS transcode, seek, resume, stop, and diagnostics export over Ethernet.
test_cases.evidence: Preflight record with network_transport=ethernet plus redacted Duskcue diagnostics and server playback decision summary

test_cases.observation: Repeat the same smoke path on Wi-Fi and compare startup, rebuffer, resume, and fallback outcome without recording SSID or IP address.
test_cases.evidence: Preflight record with network_transport=wifi plus redacted Duskcue diagnostics and server playback decision summary

test_cases.observation: Validate SDR, 4K HDR10, and Dolby Vision where the SHIELD, HDMI path, and display advertise support. Record actual display/AVR mode and any fallback; do not claim display-mode matching from a capability list.
test_cases.evidence: SHIELD display setting, display/AVR mode readout, Duskcue capability report, and result per sample

test_cases.observation: With SHIELD connected through an AVR or supported TV chain, test AAC/PCM fallback, AC-3, E-AC-3/Atmos, TrueHD, DTS, and DTS-HD where legal samples and the route allow them. Confirm the actual AVR readout and capture no audio result as a compatibility finding, not a success.
test_cases.evidence: HDMI topology, AVR/TV readout, selected audio track, Duskcue output-encoding report, and explicit passed/failed/not_supported result per sample

test_cases.observation: Switch supported text tracks and exercise image-subtitle or unsupported-track fallback through Duskcue's server decision.
test_cases.evidence: Subtitle type, visible result, server stream decision, and redacted diagnostics

test_cases.observation: Compare SHIELD Basic, Enhanced, and AI-Enhanced behavior with eligible HD content, then record expected fallback for content below 480p, over 30 Hz, or RGB color space. Duskcue must not override the user-selected SHIELD display/upscaling setting.
test_cases.evidence: SHIELD setting, sample class, observed result, and no-app-override confirmation

test_cases.observation: Use the SHIELD remote for D-pad, Select, Back, Home return, play/pause, seek, captions, audio, and Settings paths; repeat core playback controls with a paired gamepad when available.
test_cases.evidence: Checklist or short video, input type, focus/Back result, and playback-control result

test_cases.observation: Start playback, trigger SHIELD standby with the configured HDMI-CEC route, wake, and verify the app pauses/revalidates/reconnects without reusing a stale stream URL.
test_cases.evidence: Sleep/wake sequence, playback/heartbeat result, server decision after resume, and redacted diagnostics

test_cases.observation: Start and stop a movie, verify a Continue Watching entry; complete an episode and verify Next Up replacement. Confirm launcher visibility separately from successful provider writes.
test_cases.evidence: Google TV/Android TV launcher observation, profile scope, deep-link resume result, and Watch Next diagnostics aggregate

test_cases.observation: Export the user-initiated support bundle after the run and verify it contains model-class, Android, display, audio-route, decoder, HDR, and coarse network capability information while omitting secrets and personal media context.
test_cases.evidence: Manual redaction review and external retention reference only; the bundle itself is not committed

evidence_contract.retention: Keep evidence in the protected release record or issue/PR artifact. Do not commit raw diagnostics bundles, credentials, private media, screenshots with personal catalogs, serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses, SSIDs, or signed URLs.

release_gate: Task 13 is complete only after at least one SHIELD target has a complete evidence contract for every non-external test case. A public SHIELD high-capability claim additionally requires the intended signed Play artifact and Google Play visibility evidence.
